# basedpl

> bAsedPL is an APL-derived array language, borrowing ideas from J and BQN, with an emphasis on simple, consistent notation.

## Modules

- [basedpl.dyalog](https://answerdotai.github.io/basedpl/dyalog.html.md): Run Dyalog APL through RIDE for reference checks.
- [basedpl.j](https://answerdotai.github.io/basedpl/j.html.md): Run the J language from Python and Jupyter through libj: sessions, magics and a Jupyter kernel.
